summary.name: FireHydrant
summary.one_liner: FireHydrant is an incident management platform that covers on-call scheduling, alerting, automated runbooks, AI-assisted incident workflows, status pages, and post-incident retrospectives.
use_cases: coordinating incidents in Slack or Teams
setting up on-call schedules and alerts
documenting incident retrospectives and action items
sending status page updates to stakeholders
tracking mean time to mitigate and incident patterns
summary.what_it_does: The page describes FireHydrant as an all-in-one incident management platform. It offers on-call and alerting, automated runbooks, and a service catalog showing service ownership and dependencies. Incidents can be managed in Slack or Teams, with AI-generated summaries, status page updates, and live Zoom and Google Meet transcriptions. It also provides AI-enhanced retrospectives, automatically assigned follow-up action items, and analytics for MTTx metrics. The page advertises a 350+ endpoint API, Terraform support, SDKs, SOC 2 compliance, SSO, RBAC, audit logs, and SCIM.
notable: AI-generated incident summaries, status page updates, and triage channels
Live meeting transcriptions for Zoom and Google Meet
350+ API endpoints with Terraform support and SDKs
Enterprise features including SOC 2, SSO, RBAC, audit logs, and SCIM
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; it only says it is priced to fit any team.
The page is mostly marketing claims (e.g., 90% faster resolution, 91% MTTM reduction from one customer quote) without independent verification.
